steps.text: In the building north-west of the boat: key 3520 in the box (the crypt door may already be open).
steps.source: Go inside the building just northwest of the boat, and get Key 3520 from the box. It may not be necessary to get the key.

steps.text: Go into the Carlin cemetery east of town and down into the crypt at its south end.
steps.source: Enter the Carlin cemetery just east of town (Mapper Coords 126.151, 124.40, 7) and go down into the Crypt at the south end of the cemetary.

steps.text: Open the door to the west (key 3520) and go down the hole.
steps.source: Open the door to the west and look for a hole. Go down the hole.

steps.text: Follow the cave north (trolls): the fanfare is in the chest.
steps.source: Follow this path. "Use" the chest to receive the Fanfare.
